rules.when: Task needs live web facts: breaking news, current events, today's market/product state.
rules.why: Every candidate has a live web search tool. Research is not coding, so Gemini Flash's low coding score does not matter here.

rules.when: Task needs generated images or visual assets: icons, illustrations, logos, mockup art, placeholder imagery.
rules.why: Only Pi with the pi-antigravity extension can generate images.

rules.when: Review, audit, or second opinion on a diff/PR/design another crewmate produced. Not for writing the fix.
rules.why: Prefer a different model family than the author's. Antigravity Opus is used only here because Antigravity's Claude/GPT quota pool is small.

rules.when: Recon-only, file gathering, narrow lookup, or a trivial mechanical edit (rename, format sweep, typo fix).
rules.why: Cheapest models; coding quality barely matters for this work.

rules.when: Ordinary implementation, bounded bug fix, tests, everyday coding with a clear path.
rules.why: Effort is set per model: Sonnet below xhigh codes far worse than Sol medium.

rules.when: Large/ambiguous multi-file change, risky refactor, work holding many moving parts at once.
rules.why: Sol runs at xhigh, not high: Sol high scores below Sol medium.

rules.when: Hardest available work: root-cause investigation, architecture, ambiguous design, or already failed on the workhorse tier.
